review_scope: Independent mathematical reading of the finite-neighbourhood, graded point/tangent lifting, universal-entry determination and marking proofs, with bounded source-contract comparison; not a Lean kernel verification.

decisive_checks.claim: R/p^2 is finite over the coefficient DVR
decisive_checks.review: Local-point boundedness gives integrality of R/p. Every prime over (pi)+p^2 is maximal; completeness and the resulting equivalent pi-adic topology give finite generation without a flatness assumption. Derivations kill p^2, so boundedness and continuity follow.

decisive_checks.claim: Homogeneous derivations extend without assuming continuity
decisive_checks.review: Dickson minimal exponents give A=A0[z]. Finite degree-zero image and finitely many coordinate images lie in one finite coefficient extension and one bounded dual-number lattice. Total-degree tails are finite sums of shrinking monomials times uniformly bounded homogeneous images. This proves agreement and kills the full homogeneous-complete ideal, without circular use of continuity.

decisive_checks.claim: Every graded point has an allowed local torus rescaling
decisive_checks.review: The degree-zero algebra is local by homogeneous inversion and its finite quotient has nilpotent maximal ideal modulo pi. Mixed invariant monomials therefore have strictly positive valuation. This yields a nonempty strict interval of rescaling valuations, with zeros and missing sign constraints handled. The rescaling preserves the homogeneous equations and extends exactly, rather than approximating the point.

The pinned universal property is for raw framed lifts and uniquely determines the algebra map. Residual dual-number tests imply cotangent spanning by finitely many entry differences; Nakayama and completeness give topological generation. Continuous derivations killing those entries vanish.

decisive_checks.claim: The normalized coboundary space has at most one parameter
decisive_checks.review: Semidirect inverse-transpose signs give X+J X^t J=0. The exact marking gives M-J M^t J=zeta diag(1,0,-1). Its two differentiated off-diagonal entries force the remaining entries to vanish when 2 and zeta are units. Thus X=a diag(1,0,-1), including the original primitive, not merely an equivalence class.

decisive_checks.claim: Torus transport preserves the two-sided tangent conclusion
decisive_checks.review: On homogeneous degree j, multiply both point and tangent by t^j. This is an invertible linear map on tangent spaces, preserves equation annihilation and sign-coordinate vanishing, and matches the precise source interface. The local finite condition and non-diagonal rigidity remain assumptions.

retained_obligations: actual weighted model, initial chart and finite degree-zero quotient
uniform bounds for integral Selmer torsion
limits: Finite calculations do not prove infinite-series limits or representability.
Coefficient extensions and bounds are pointwise; no uniform numerical field-degree or denominator estimate follows.
No full proof of RH or Dirichlet GRH is asserted.
